name: Wind-tunnel testing
summary: A model or a car stands in a tunnel with a strong air flow. The test shows how the body pushes the air and how much drag it makes.
how: Fix the model to the balance in the tunnel.
Run the fan at a set speed and measure the drag and the lift.
Change the body form and test again.

origin.note: Francis Wenham builds the first wind tunnel for the Aeronautical Society.

adoptions.via: Designers test streamlined bodies in the tunnel and cut the drag.
Designers tune the smooth underbody and the small mirrors in the tunnel.
Makers tune the flat floor and the flush door handles for range.
